policy.storage_only: The Experience Store stores history; it never judges a story and never edits a rule.
policy.reference_only: An experience record points at existing derived artifacts; it never copies or overrides them.
policy.not_authority: Experience is derived data; it never replaces episode-state.json or story-gates.json.
policy.no_score: Audience feedback is stored as raw facts and free text; this layer never turns it into a score or a threshold.
policy.advisory_only: An experience record never blocks production.
